contentPattern.structure: many rows, each a landing panel: cells are columns (text, image, or an image gallery); image-only rows become image strips

usage: A full landing-page stack (hero, offers, info panels, image strip, service cards) captured as one block on the self-employed taxes page.
reuseGuidance: Prefer splitting into dedicated blocks (columns-banner, columns-promo-card, cards) when re-authoring; this block keeps the composed stack renderable as imported.
